attributes.content:
**EL-RSP-1.2 Turn decision to bus within 60 ms**

BCM_Lighting shall send the TurnLightControl frame carrying the new turn state within 60 ms of receiving the TurnStalk or HazardLightButton frame that caused it: at most 10 ms of processing plus at most one 50 ms TurnLightControl cycle.

The first on-phase shall be output when the new state is entered, not at the first blink tick.

description: Obligation of BCM_Lighting as LightingControl in ExteriorLightingDesign (EL-RSP-1.2).

Realized by ImplementedBCM_Lighting: on_turn_stalk() and on_hazard_button() update the restbus signals in the same handler, and the entered state left_on, right_on or hazard_on already carries the on value. Processing time is allocated to BCM_ECU (BCM_ECU_Lighting_Reaction) through ComputeAllocation_BCM_Lighting; the 50 ms cycle to BodyCan0 (BodyCan0_LightingControl_Cycle) through CommunicateAllocation_BodyCan0.
